title: He Alone Serves The Lord, Whom
summary: The shabad does not leave purpose at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: O Nanak, he alone serves the Lord, whom the Lord attaches to Himself
lifeApplication: Choose one act today that treats life as opportunity instead of drift. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
